title: Customer discovery
description: Leave the building and replace your assumptions with evidence. You will run honest customer interviews, synthesize what you hear and choose the segment where your problem is sharpest.
objectives: Rewrite your riskiest assumptions as hypotheses with fail lines set in advance
Write an interview guide based on the Mom Test that asks about past behavior, not opinions
Run at least 10 customer interviews and ask each serious prospect for a concrete commitment
Build a synthesis board that counts and grades findings by segment
Write an evidence-based ideal customer profile and name your early adopters
Decide whether to persevere, adjust or pivot, and explain the evidence behind the decision
resources: Steve Blank, What's a Startup? First Principles — https://steveblank.com/2010/01/25/whats-a-startup-first-principles/
Steve Blank, How to Build a Startup (Udacity) — https://www.udacity.com/course/how-to-build-a-startup--ep245
Rob Fitzpatrick, The Mom Test — https://www.momtestbook.com/
Eric Migicovsky, How to Talk to Users (YC Startup School) — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MT4Ig2uqjTc
Gustaf Alströmer, How to Talk to Users (YC Startup Library) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/Iq-how-to-talk-to-users
YC's Group Partners share their favorite pivot stories — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/Iy-yc-s-group-partners-share-their-favorite-pivot-stories

es.title: Descubrimiento de clientes
es.description: Sal del edificio y reemplaza tus supuestos con evidencia. Harás entrevistas honestas con clientes, sintetizarás lo que escuches y elegirás el segmento donde tu problema es más agudo.
objectives: Reescribir tus supuestos más riesgosos como hipótesis con criterios de fracaso definidos de antemano
Escribir una guía de entrevista basada en The Mom Test que pregunte por comportamientos pasados, no por opiniones
Hacer al menos 10 entrevistas con clientes y pedir a cada prospecto serio un compromiso concreto
Construir un tablero de síntesis que cuente y califique los hallazgos por segmento
Escribir un perfil de cliente ideal basado en evidencia y nombrar a tus primeros adoptantes
Decidir si perseverar, ajustar o pivotar, y explicar la evidencia detrás de la decisión
resources: Steve Blank, What's a Startup? First Principles (qué es una startup) — https://steveblank.com/2010/01/25/whats-a-startup-first-principles/
Steve Blank, How to Build a Startup (curso en Udacity) — https://www.udacity.com/course/how-to-build-a-startup--ep245
Rob Fitzpatrick, The Mom Test (sitio del libro) — https://www.momtestbook.com/
Eric Migicovsky, cómo hablar con usuarios (YC Startup School) — https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MT4Ig2uqjTc
Gustaf Alströmer, cómo hablar con usuarios (YC Startup Library) — https://www.ycombinator.com/library/Iq-how-to-talk-to-users
